name: 01 · Home
note: Home separates recorded remaining from projected remaining. Income and spending figures are not an account balance. Calendar and money-flow tools move into Explore your month.

name: 02 · Activity
note: Keep category filtering directly on the list: All, frequent categories and Filters. Filters exposes the complete category list. Category buttons filter in place during implementation; this storyboard uses a representative filtered result. Filters never change the period totals.

name: 05 · Calendar
note: Calendar selection filters the entry list. Scheduled previews have a named state and never look like recorded entries.

name: 07 · Money flow
note: Replaces the phone-width horizontal Sankey with a readable stacked flow. Segment widths use exact amounts. A future expanded Sankey can remain available on desktop.

name: 08 · Add expense
note: Frequent categories are selected inline without a popup or page change. All categories opens the full list only when needed. Chips are static in this storyboard; implementation updates the selection in place and keeps the selected category visible even when it is not frequent. Keyboard scrolls above the save action. Failed saves preserve the draft.

name: 17 · Choose date
note: Use the platform date picker at implementation time. This screen specifies the selected value and save behavior, not a custom OS dialog.

name: 21 · Receipt preview
note: The receipt content is clearly fictional. Native PDFs open/share through the system; web uses its paginated PDF viewer. Image receipts use an in-app image viewer.

name: 22 · Shared households
note: Household balances remain separate by month. A previous unpaid month remains visible even after the calendar moves on.

name: 24 · Monthly balances
note: Monthly recording is available from the last calendar day of the month. Current-month early payment is recorded on an individual expense share instead. The second $60 suggestion to Alex remains in the scrollable list.

name: 25 · Add shared expense
note: Only the payer can attach one of their private accounts. Members see the receipt, payer, total, shares, and history; the payer’s account details stay private.

name: 26 · Split among members
note: Amount and percent modes expose one field per eligible member, including zero shares. Show allocated and remaining totals; disable save until allocations equal the receipt.

name: 28 · Shared expense details
note: Paid shares lock the payer, total, allocation, month and deletion. Details that do not affect the settled amount remain editable.

name: 29 · Record paid share
note: The full eligible share is confirmed. Either the repaying member or original payer may record it. Stale or ineligible payments require reopening the latest expense.

name: 30 · Record monthly payment
note: Once a monthly reimbursement exists, individual payment recording closes for that month to prevent double counting.

name: 31 · People & household settings
note: Creator-only actions include invitation, rename, remove and archive. Remove or leave is blocked while monthly balances remain outstanding; past expenses stay unchanged.

name: 38 · Shared trip
note: Trip totals span travel dates; reimbursements remain monthly. Expenses that predate sharing stay private. Bookings outside trip dates remain allowed.

name: 43 · Trip monthly balances
note: For $1,260 split three ways: you paid $360 and owe $60; Mira paid $900 and is owed $480; Alex paid $0 and owes $420. Individual examples preserve this accounting.

name: 45 · Recurring
note: Each schedule has one detail entry point. Pause, resume and remove live in the detail screen so they do not compete on every list row.

name: 54 · Settings
note: App lock and server selection are native-only controls. On web omit them and use the current origin. Do not expose a server editor over an active workspace.

name: 61 · Sign in
note: Native server entry point is shown here. Web uses its own origin. Show the server’s OIDC action only when configured; the optional SSO specimen documents that variation.

name: 62 · Create account
note: Native server entry point is shown here. Web uses its own origin. Show the server’s OIDC action only when configured; the optional SSO specimen documents that variation.

name: 64 · Penny is locked
note: While locked, hide all ledger content and open dialogs. Failed authentication keeps this screen visible; retry uses the same button. Do not replace the operating system biometric prompt with an app imitation.

name: 65 · First entry / empty home
note: A first-use state does not show meaningless zero-value charts. Currency can still be selected before the first entry.

name: 67 · Demo / temporary sample data
note: Home separates recorded remaining from projected remaining. Income and spending figures are not an account balance. Calendar and money-flow tools move into Explore your month.

name: 73 · Expense saved
note: This expanded success specimen documents feedback. In normal use, return directly to the source screen with a brief save toast and native haptic rather than interrupting with a dedicated success screen.

name: 79 · Sign out / synced
note: When personal changes are pending, replace the sign-out action with a disabled action and an explanation linking to Sync status.
